connect_iff.detail: Reach-built nonempty signed store; all invariant fields proved, queue emptiness checked; Bob connects before removal and is refused afterward. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application. Also newDeviceTrusted: Carol, a new device Alice (a current member) approved under removed Bob's node key, is let in, her admission trusted (the trusted view), while Bob's device stays admitted and removed in the same store.

deviceLive_iff.detail: Admitted Bob is live before removal; removed Bob is not live afterward, including after another device joins his node. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

refuse_nonmember.detail: Actually admitted then removed Bob, not an empty outsider: singleton byKey rows prove every device at his node is cut. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

connect_approved.detail: The accepted key belongs to non-founder Bob, with actual invitation/approval/admission ancestry. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

connect_agree.detail: Two real model stores ingest the signed ops in opposite orders; finite lookup checks plus reach_stored prove equality of their entire ops maps; both queues settle. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

removal_cuts_off.detail: Actual removal and admission facts; singleton byKey query proves the universally quantified node ownership premise. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

cut_stays.detail: Actual cut device plus a genuinely new op arrival. The ingestion extension is proved for arbitrary stores; fixture newness is checked. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

cut_consented.detail: Actual removed Bob admission and removal construct Cut; theorem extracts his signed request binding. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

removals_iff.detail: Actual removal of Bob in a nonempty settled store, alongside before/after live-members checks. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

recipients_iff.detail: Before removal Bob is a content-key recipient; after removal his node is excluded. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

members_iff.detail: Two live members before mutual removal, zero afterward; the actual list query is executed. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

connect_admitted.detail: Actual root/request/approval premises, a singleton distinct-approver proof, and deviceLive-derived unremoved premise accept Bob. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application. Alice's approval counts, read by the counts view and counts_iff.

endpoint_signed.detail: Actual non-founder admission of Bob binds his distinct node key under his request signature. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

endpoint_derives.detail: Production SHA-256 creates a deterministic 32-byte test seed; the actual X25519 endpoint fact derives its public key. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

profile_authorized.detail: Bob signs a nonempty profile; Mallory signing a profile while citing Bob is rejected. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

mine_not_removed.detail: Actual local acceptance plus device secret selects Bob before removal; missing secret and removed Bob both return no held entry. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

no_renaming.detail: Actual valid signed profile premise is witnessed and a wrong-device profile is rejected. Attribution to the key holder assumes Unforgeable ed25519 over this store: no forged signature among the ones it holds (Ed25519 unforgeability, a computational assumption). The premise is satisfiable with an informative Signed (Vacuity.Contracts.unforgeableScoped).

approveReq_wrap_admits.detail: Alice's actual approveReq over a Reach-built store holding her community, the invitation, Bob's signed request and her copy of the community key, with a 32-byte ephemeral secret: the law is applied to the write the intent produces, which has three ops, so (the law's third case) it is her approval (citing the up and prev links it read), the admission citing it, and her wrap of the key currentKey reads. Controls: without the key the write is approval and admission; without the request it is the bare approval.

no_self_readmission.detail: Alice removes Bob citing his chain head (his approval of Dave); Bob, removed, invites and approves a fresh device naming his own node key, one place past the head. Every Valid approval naming Bob's key is checked from the store: for Bob's own device (cut), or by Bob outside the cut; the law then refuses Bob's node. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

outside_cut_admits_none.detail: Bob's actual approval past Alice's cut: the cut view refuses it on the real store, inCut_iff turns that into not InCut, and the law gives that neither it nor anything above it counts. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

inside_cut_stays.detail: Bob's approval of Dave counts before Alice's removal (counts view on the store Alice had seen) and, with its up-path kept by the removal's cut (kept view after the removal, path walked by Above), still counts after: no cascade. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

trust_agree.detail: The cut store and its reversed arrival order hold the same ops; trusted and allowPeer agree for Bob's fresh device on his node key. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

trust_order_free.detail: Reach-built stores from the cut ops in two arrival orders, distinctness checked; the law gives equal trust and trust-rule verdicts. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

trusted_iff.detail: Applied at rest to the cut store for Bob's fresh device on his own node key (the view answers false there). Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

counts_iff.detail: Applied to Bob's actual approval of Dave (depth 1, up Alice's approval of Bob) on the cut store. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

kept_iff.detail: Applied to Bob's actual approval past the cut, on the store holding Alice's removal of Bob. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

inCut_iff.detail: Applied to Bob's approval of Dave and Alice's actual removal citing it as Bob's chain head. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

approval_links.detail: Bob's actual approval past the cut: depth 1 (up Alice's approval of Bob) and place 1 (prev his approval of Dave). Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

removal_cut.detail: Alice's actual removal of Bob, as the remover flow writes it: its cut names Bob's approval of Dave at place 0. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto; successful runtime branches construct premises, Lean checks theorem application.

removeMember_keeps.detail: Alice's actual remover flow over the store she had seen writes the removal of Bob citing his chain head; settled store, the write, the extension, the stored op, the heads cap, Bob's places below 2^64 and his unforked chain are all checked from the store, and the law keeps Bob's approval of Dave inside the cut. Universal correctness of Ed25519 signatures for every message remains open; the named theorem is applied conditionally on it, as removeMember_valid is.

removal_anchored.detail: Bob's signed self-removal citing his own admission as its authority is judged Valid on the Reach-built signed store, and the theorem is applied to it. Controls: the same self-removal citing his message (which the old rule, any shared fact, took) and one citing Alice's admission are refused. Synthetic signed fixture, real crypto.
